Please switch the puzzle's status to WIP to allow more time for reviewers to review it.

Also, please remember to format the statement properly.

Thanks.

Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format the statement by following the example there.

[[ ]] for variable names.
{{ }} for constants.
<< >> for bold (e.g. line numbers).

Thanks.
thanks for the feedback all fixed

General
* The task is too easy as a puzzle. Please rework it as a clash of code instead.

Input
* In "Next N lines", please format "N" as a [[variable]].

Constraints
* Please remove the constraint "All input values are integers" as this is already specified in the Input section.

* Please change 100000 to 10 as [[N]] never exceeds 10 in the existing cases.

* Please replace both instances of 1000000000 with 10⁹.

Stub generator
* The stub generator uses the variable names "travel", "period", "window" and "offset", whereas the other sections use "T", "P", "W" and "O". Please standardise the variable names to ensure consistency.

Cases
* Almost all cases violate the constraint 0 <= O < P. Please review and adjust the cases and/or the constraint as appropriate.

* These cases are the same:
  • Mixed security gates (Test 1)
  • Very large time values (Test 5)
  Besides, all input values in Test 5 are less than 10, so the case doesn't cover the scenario suggested by its name. Please revise it accordingly, ensuring that the input and output values are similar to those used in Validator 5.

* There's a significant gap in input-value coverage, with values between 11 and 999999795 largely unrepresented. Please add more case pairs to ensure that this range is covered in a balanced manner, with separate consideration for tests and validators.

Thanks.
